newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy metalworker talks to resume Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Italy metalworker talks to resume Tuesday.

text.p: Talks between unions and employers in Italy's engineering and metalworking industry to try to end their pay dispute will resume on Tuesday morning, a union spokesman said.
A spokesman for the UILM union said the sides, after an initial round of talks that lasted for more than three hours, would resume talks at 0900 GMT on Tuesday.
Monday's talks were the first for more than a month in a battle that has already seen three one-day strikes since it began last June when the sector's two-year contract agreement expired.

The talks took place at the Labour Ministry after Prime Minister Romano Prodi met leaders of Italy's three main labour confederations, CGIL, CISL and UIL, and the employers' umbrella group Confindustria to try to break the deadlock. --Rome newsroom +39 6 678 2505
